title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(長尾隆司研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Nagao Takashi)
educationalGoal: Graduation research is carried out as Project Design III. This course aims to help students: ・Understand the fundamentals of neurobiology and neuroethology. ・Plan and implement their own experiments. ・Discuss their results and provide feedback for the next plan. ・Summarize research achievements in a report and give an oral presentation.
advice: The course will provide information which should enable the student to explain: 1. Generic skills and science literacy (logical thinking, critical thinking, knowledge synthesis). 2. Difference between science and religion (originality, falsifiability, plagiarism). 3. Historical views of brain science. 4. Neural basis of sensory information systems. 5. Neural basis of motor control systems. 6. Neural basis of brain control of behavior. 7. Learning and memory. 8. Goals, executive control and action. 9. Emotion (fear, emotional influences on perception and attention, the reward system). 10. Neural and neurochemical basis of behavior. 11. Nature versus nurture of behavior. 12. Evolution of behavior. The course will provide opportunities for: observing and analyzing behavior. developing skills in the critical reading of primary literature in neuroethology. developing analytical skills to be able to propose experiments.
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of neuroscience and evolution are required. In order to understand knowledge and laws, the habit of learning the history from which they were obtained is required.

activityGoals.body: Implement a project design process according to your research theme.
Prepare a report and deliver an oral presentation properly based on experimental results.
Explain previous reports in related fields.
